mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear skies with a pleasant temperature of 70 degrees at Verona Community Park. We are under a First Quarter moon, and if you stay up, you can catch the space station at 10:22 PM as it streaks from over Cross Plains toward Oregon near Costco, climbing about halfway up the sky.

On the city front, don't forget that VHAT provides local government updates and public access programming. Also, a reminder that the city has specific ordinances regarding vehicle storage on your property, requiring designated parking surfaces and specific setbacks.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today you can visit the farmer's market, enjoy pizza at Lake Louie, or test your brain at trivia night. Tomorrow, make sure to catch the free Concerts in the Park at Century School Park or join the fun at Hop Haus trivia.
In our weekly police report, on July 13, officers responded to a situation where a vehicle was found stuck on a large rock, resulting in the driver being arrested for an O-W-I.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Mint Explosion. Culver's is open until 10 PM, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a treat today.
